description:
# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.20

Source check: opi-q5k.20 (tui-cell-size-input.test.ts audit)

## Nature of the gap

Upstream tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-cell-size-input.test.ts asserts two behaviors of the TUI when running against an image-capable terminal:

1. A bare ESC sent by the user after startup is forwarded to the focused component (i.e. the startup cell-size query, if any, does not swallow user ESC).
2. A cell-size *response* `\e[6;HEIGHT;WIDTHt` is consumed by the TUI (not forwarded), updates the cached cell dimensions, and later ordinary keystrokes are still forwarded.

Our apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image.ex treats `cell_dims` as a pure-function parameter with a fixed default `%{width_px: 9, height_px: 18}`. It has no startup query, no response parser, and no cached dimension state. The upstream feature is **not implemented** on the Elixir side.

## Decision required

The processing agent MUST decide one of:

**A. Implement the feature and port the tests.**
  - Add startup query emission when capabilities indicate image support (Ghostty, Kitty, iTerm2, WezTerm, VSCode per terminal_image_test.exs).
  - Add a parser path (likely in StdinFSM or a TUI-level consumer) that recognizes `\e[6;H;Wt` reply shape, consumes it, updates cached dims, and does not forward it.
  - Add module-level cached cell dims with getter/setter (or supervised state — follow project convention).
  - Port the two upstream tests to Elixir integration style (avoid Process.sleep per memory feedback_no_process_sleep_in_tests; sync via telemetry/subscription).

**B. Deliberately decline the feature.**
  - Document in the project (AGENTS.md or a new ADR under /docs if conventional) that cell-size queries are out of scope and that image sizing relies on the fixed default `{width_px: 9, height_px: 18}`.
  - Post a final comment here citing the rationale and the location of the written decision. Do NOT port the tests.

Do not half-implement.

## Re-comparison (required if path A chosen)

After implementation + test port, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-cell-size-input.test.ts and confirm both upstream tests have equivalent Elixir tests. Post a final comment on this ticket with that re-comparison before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).

## References
- Upstream TUI startup/query logic: grep tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src for "14t" and "cellSize"
- Our terminal_image: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image.ex
- Our stdin parser: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/stdin_fsm.ex

comments.text: Path B (decline) taken. TerminalImage moduledoc now records the rationale. The 2 upstream tui-cell-size-input.test.ts tests are N/A for our architecture; no tests ported. If/when an interactive TUI runtime with startup handshake is built, re-open this ticket to implement the feature.

title: Port tui-cell-size-input.test.ts: decide fate of startup cell-size query
